chapterInfo.content:
17
Elia hyɛ ɔhaw ho nkɔm
1 # Yak 5.17; Adi 11.6 Na Tisbini Elia a ɔfiri Gilead atubrafoɔ mu ka kyerɛɛ Ahab sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn a megyina n’anim te aseɛ yi, obosuo anaa osuo rentɔ mfeɛ yi mu gye sɛ ɛnam m’asɛm so! 2Na AWURADE asɛm baa ne nkyɛn sɛ: 3Firi ha kɔ, na dane wo ho kɔ apueeɛ, na kɔhunta asuo Kerit a ɛwɔ Yordan anim no ho. 4Na wobɛnom asuo no mu nsuo, na mahyɛ anene sɛ wɔnhwɛ wo wɔ hɔ. 5Na ɔsii mu kɔyɛɛ sɛdeɛ AWURADE asɛm no teɛ, na ɔkɔ kɔtenaa asuo Kerit a ɛwɔ Yordan apueeɛ no ho. 6Na anene brɛɛ no paanoo ne nam anɔpa, ne anwummerɛ, na ɔnomm asuo no mu nsuo bi. 7Na ɛbaa sɛ nna bi akyiri no, asuo no wee, ɛfiri sɛ osuo antɔ asase no so.
Elia wɔ Sarefat ɔbaa kunafoɔ bi nkyɛn
8Na AWURADE asɛm baa ne nkyɛn sɛ: 9#Luka 4.25-26 Sɔre kɔ Sarefat a ɛyɛ Sidonfoɔ deɛ no, na kɔtena hɔ; na hwɛ, mahyɛ ɔbaa kunafoɔ bi wɔ hɔ sɛ ɔnhwɛ wo. 10Na ɔsɔre kɔɔ Sarefat. Na ɔduruu kuro no pono ano no, na hwɛ, ɔbaa kunafoɔ no wɔ hɔ repɛ mmaboa. Na ɔfrɛɛ no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Kɔsa nsuo kakra gu kuruwa mu brɛ me na mennom. 11Na ɔrekɔ akɔsa no, ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Fa paanoo afono ma kura wo nsam brɛ me. 12#1 Ah 18.10 Na ɔse: Sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn te aseɛ yi, atodeɛ biara nni me nsam, gye esiam nsa ma a ɛwɔ kuruwa mu, ne ngo kakra a ɛwɔ toa mu, na hwɛ, merepɛ mmaboa mmienu bi makɔ makɔto, na me ne me ba adi na yɛawu. 13Na Elia ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Nsuro, kɔyɛ sɛdeɛ woaka no, na kɔfa bi yɛ ɔfam ketewaa bi nso ma me kane, na fa brɛ me, na ɛno akyiri no yɛ wo ne wo ba deɛ. 14#2 Ah 4.2-4 Na sɛ AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Esiam kuruwa no so renhwan, na ngo toa no so rente de bɛkɔ akɔsi da a AWURADE bɛma osuo atɔ agu asase no soɔ. 15Na ɔkɔ kɔyɛɛ sɛdeɛ Elia ka kyerɛɛ no no, na ɔdii, ɔno ne ɔbaa no ne ne fiefoɔ, nna pii; 16na esiam kuruwa no so anhwan, na ngo toa no so ante, sɛdeɛ AWURADE asɛm a ɔnam Elia so kaeɛ no teɛ no.
17Na nsɛm yi akyiri no, ɔbaa fiewura no babarima yaree, na ne yadeɛ no mu yɛɛ den pii kɔsii sɛ ɔwuiɛ. 18#Luka 5.8 Na ɔbaa no ka kyerɛɛ Elia sɛ: Wo Nyankopɔn nipa, ɛdeɛn na me ne wo wɔ yɛ? Wobaa me nkyɛn sɛ worebɛma wɔakae me bɔne na wɔakum me ba! 19Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Fa wo ba no brɛ me! Na ɔgyee no firii ne kokom de no kɔɔ abansoro pia a ɔte mu no mu, na ɔde no kɔtoo ne mpa so. 20Na ɔteaa mu frɛɛ AWURADE sɛ: AWURADE me Nyankopɔn, ɔbaa kunafoɔ yi nso a mabɛsoɛ ne nkyɛn yi, wode mmusuo reba ne so sɛ worekum ne ba yi? 21#2 Ah 4.34; Aso 20.10 Na ɔtenee ne mu butuu abɔfra no so mprɛnsa, na ɔteaa mu frɛɛ AWURADE sɛ: AWURADE me Nyankopɔn, ma abɔfra yi kra nsane mmra ne mu. 22Na AWURADE tiee Elia nne, na abɔfra no kra sane baa ne mu, na ɔnyaa nkwa. 23#Luka 7.15; Heb 11.35 Na Elia faa abɔfra no de no siane firii abansoro pia mu baa ɛdan no mu, na ɔde no brɛɛ ne na, na Elia se: Hwɛ, wo ba anya nkwa. 24Na ɔbaa no ka kyerɛɛ Elia sɛ: Afei na mahunu sɛ Nyankopɔn nipa ne wo, na AWURADE asɛm a ɛwɔ w’anomu yɛ nokorɛ.

Na Tisbini Elia a ɔfiri Gilead atubrafoɔ mu ka kyerɛɛ Ahab sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn a megyina n’anim te aseɛ yi, obosuo anaa osuo rentɔ mfeɛ yi mu gye sɛ ɛnam m’asɛm so! Na AWURADE asɛm baa ne nkyɛn sɛ: Firi ha kɔ, na dane wo ho kɔ apueeɛ, na kɔhunta asuo Kerit a ɛwɔ Yordan anim no ho. Na wobɛnom asuo no mu nsuo, na mahyɛ anene sɛ wɔnhwɛ wo wɔ hɔ. Na ɔsii mu kɔyɛɛ sɛdeɛ AWURADE asɛm no teɛ, na ɔkɔ kɔtenaa asuo Kerit a ɛwɔ Yordan apueeɛ no ho. Na anene brɛɛ no paanoo ne nam anɔpa, ne anwummerɛ, na ɔnomm asuo no mu nsuo bi. Na ɛbaa sɛ nna bi akyiri no, asuo no wee, ɛfiri sɛ osuo antɔ asase no so.

Na AWURADE asɛm baa ne nkyɛn sɛ: Sɔre kɔ Sarefat a ɛyɛ Sidonfoɔ deɛ no, na kɔtena hɔ; na hwɛ, mahyɛ ɔbaa kunafoɔ bi wɔ hɔ sɛ ɔnhwɛ wo. Na ɔsɔre kɔɔ Sarefat. Na ɔduruu kuro no pono ano no, na hwɛ, ɔbaa kunafoɔ no wɔ hɔ repɛ mmaboa. Na ɔfrɛɛ no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Kɔsa nsuo kakra gu kuruwa mu brɛ me na mennom. Na ɔrekɔ akɔsa no, ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Fa paanoo afono ma kura wo nsam brɛ me. Na ɔse: Sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn te aseɛ yi, atodeɛ biara nni me nsam, gye esiam nsa ma a ɛwɔ kuruwa mu, ne ngo kakra a ɛwɔ toa mu, na hwɛ, merepɛ mmaboa mmienu bi makɔ makɔto, na me ne me ba adi na yɛawu. Na Elia ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Nsuro, kɔyɛ sɛdeɛ woaka no, na kɔfa bi yɛ ɔfam ketewaa bi nso ma me kane, na fa brɛ me, na ɛno akyiri no yɛ wo ne wo ba deɛ. Na sɛ AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Esiam kuruwa no so renhwan, na ngo toa no so rente de bɛkɔ akɔsi da a AWURADE bɛma osuo atɔ agu asase no soɔ. Na ɔkɔ kɔyɛɛ sɛdeɛ Elia ka kyerɛɛ no no, na ɔdii, ɔno ne ɔbaa no ne ne fiefoɔ, nna pii; na esiam kuruwa no so anhwan, na ngo toa no so ante, sɛdeɛ AWURADE asɛm a ɔnam Elia so kaeɛ no teɛ no.
Na nsɛm yi akyiri no, ɔbaa fiewura no babarima yaree, na ne yadeɛ no mu yɛɛ den pii kɔsii sɛ ɔwuiɛ. Na ɔbaa no ka kyerɛɛ Elia sɛ: Wo Nyankopɔn nipa, ɛdeɛn na me ne wo wɔ yɛ? Wobaa me nkyɛn sɛ worebɛma wɔakae me bɔne na wɔakum me ba! Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Fa wo ba no brɛ me! Na ɔgyee no firii ne kokom de no kɔɔ abansoro pia a ɔte mu no mu, na ɔde no kɔtoo ne mpa so. Na ɔteaa mu frɛɛ AWURADE sɛ: AWURADE me Nyankopɔn, ɔbaa kunafoɔ yi nso a mabɛsoɛ ne nkyɛn yi, wode mmusuo reba ne so sɛ worekum ne ba yi? Na ɔtenee ne mu butuu abɔfra no so mprɛnsa, na ɔteaa mu frɛɛ AWURADE sɛ: AWURADE me Nyankopɔn, ma abɔfra yi kra nsane mmra ne mu. Na AWURADE tiee Elia nne, na abɔfra no kra sane baa ne mu, na ɔnyaa nkwa. Na Elia faa abɔfra no de no siane firii abansoro pia mu baa ɛdan no mu, na ɔde no brɛɛ ne na, na Elia se: Hwɛ, wo ba anya nkwa. Na ɔbaa no ka kyerɛɛ Elia sɛ: Afei na mahunu sɛ Nyankopɔn nipa ne wo, na AWURADE asɛm a ɛwɔ w’anomu yɛ nokorɛ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
